asset_set: Questionnaire Q10 option 1 — Building sustainable furniture

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under hands and stool — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle wood grain suggestion on stool via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: tactile sustainable-maker energy — cozy workshop craft, not an industrial mill
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: KursoKo teal
accent.use: eco-leaf brand stamp, glue bottle cap, apron strap pinstripe

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: teal appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlights on stool leg and sanding block
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and stool base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: pins the stool frame steady on the workbench
left_hand.grip: spread fingers, thumb bracing the leg joint
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: guides a sanding block along the stool leg grain
right_hand.grip: firm palm grip, fingers curled over the block

pose.gesture_summary: mid-sanding stroke freeze frame — wood shavings lifting
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

top.garment: canvas work apron strap over shirt
top.fabric: sturdy cotton canvas over cotton shirt

accessories.placement: both hands — fingertips cut out exposing skin for dexterity

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands sands the leg of a handcrafted wooden stool at a workshop bench, curls of wood shavings drifting from the motion. The left hand steadies the stool frame while the right hand guides a sanding block along the grain, a small eco-leaf stamp branded faintly into the underside — the satisfying, tactile moment of sustainable craft in progress.

primary_objects.name: wooden stool
primary_objects.detail: visible wood grain via 3 parallel lines max, small teal eco-leaf brand stamp on the underside

primary_objects.name: sanding block
primary_objects.material: wood block with sandpaper texture suggestion
primary_objects.detail: flat rectangular shape, simple grip notch

primary_objects.name: wood shavings
primary_objects.detail: two or three curled flat shapes drifting near the sanding motion

primary_objects.detail: resting at bench edge, teal cap

subject.environment: light workshop bench strip across bottom third with subtle wood grain suggestion, fades to transparent
